title: Morpho Steakhouse USDC (Ethereum): routine 48 h, 5–6 May 2026
summary: A quiet 48-hour window for one of the largest Morpho Ethereum USDC vaults (Steakhouse USDC, about 124–136M USDC), whose main markets lend against WBTC, cbBTC, wstETH and WETH. The curator accepted three timelocked caps on new blue-chip markets, posted a routine weETH onboarding proposal on the Morpho forum that also reminded V1 users to migrate to V2, reordered queues, and submitted a timelocked weETH cap. An allocator rebalanced liquidity every 30 minutes and hourly utilization stayed between 88% and 92%. The only alerts were an unrelated $1.4M Ekubo router exploit on Ethereum (Ekubo and Blockaid posts, ForkLog article) and a normal ~9% six-hour swing in vault deposits. A correct judge stays at low/hold throughout, with at most a brief 'elevated' read on the Ekubo alert if it cannot rule out exposure.

positions_considered.description: Supplies USDC to the Steakhouse USDC MetaMorpho vault on Ethereum (no debt); about $1,000 position.

t_first_public_signal.description: No risk signal relevant to the vault. The closest minor alert is the Ekubo incident post at 2026-05-05T20:02:42Z, which is unrelated.

t_point_of_no_return.definition: Not applicable: no market reached 99% utilization and the share price never fell.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: No loss. Share price rose from 1.125083 to 1.125302 (+0.019%) over 48 h. Withdrawals were available at all times, with 14–30M USDC idle in each of the two largest markets.

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: No trigger. There is no debt for a health-factor rule, and BTC and ETH moved within a 4% range. Any price-only rule stays silent, which is correct here.

ideal_action.rationale: Nothing in the window threatened the vault's markets or collateral.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: Routine caps, forum post and reallocations; utilization near the 90% IRM target.
Acceptable to note an active Ethereum exploit (Ekubo) until it is clear the vault has no exposure; no action needed. 'low' is equally acceptable.
Ekubo is scoped to a router extension; vault deposits swing normally; share price smooth.

items.author: Steakhouse (forum.morpho.org)
items.verbatim_text: Steakhouse proposes onboarding weETH as eligible collateral for Steakhouse Prime Morpho vaults across ETH and USD lending markets. The proposal follows a full protocol review benchmarked against our internal Prime risk framework. EtherFi has delivered the governance changes required to meet the Prime threshold. As a reminder, we also suggest Steakhouse USDC (Vault V1) users to migrate to Steakhouse USDC Prime Instant (v2) via the migration tool available on our app or on the Morpho frontend.
